insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Jarvan IV is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Jarvan IV in 20/47 games (43%): 4 picks (1-3) and 16 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Orianna? They go Hwei
insights.text: Orianna is a G1 favorite (4/16 G1s, played by Quad). In the 21 later games where it was burned or banned, Quad went to Hwei (3/21) and Taliyah (2/21).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Ambessa against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Ambessa against them in 21/47 games (45%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 15 G3+ games, 37/75 picks (49%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 41 champs in G1s, 47 in G3+.
